Consequently, I looked upwards and saw a "V" formation of seven large luminous, pale yellow disks just coming up from the west side of town, and heading east, and disappearing over the eastern horizon.
I cannot comment on how high they were, nor can I comment on how large they were.  They appeared to be huge, and were featureless.  The disks made no sound.  The disks appeared to be very close to each other.  The formation did pretty much fill the sky as they went over my head.
